title: Import wizard: "Match on" offers a multi-value or structured field the server refuses as a match key
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible), split from #27465 (the server half).


### Business reason
Who: anyone importing into an object with a `multiple: true` lookup, a multiselect / tags / checkboxes field, or a json-like field, in "Update existing" or "Update if matched, else create" mode (reported by an Enterprise customer on 17.3.0).
What happens today: the wizard offers such a field as a match key. After #27465's server half lands, ticking it gets the whole import refused with `400 INVALID_REQUEST` ("matchFields names "work_object" (lookup, multiple: true), which holds a list or a structured value ..."); before it, every row failed on a raw SQL-binding error. Either way the wizard offered a choice the server can never serve.
Without the fix: the user still picks a key that cannot work and only learns it at Validate.

### Where
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx` (the options step): `const matchable = useMemo(() => fields.filter((f) => mappedFieldNames.has(f.name)), ...)` offers every mapped field.
- The wizard's field shape does not carry `multiple` (see the `refusedOptionValue` docblock in the same file), so it cannot tell a `multiple: true` lookup apart.

### Rule to follow (the server's, one definition)
A field cannot be a match key when it is stored as a JSON column: `isMultiValueField(field)` or `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES.has(field.type)` (both `@objectstack/spec/data`). Server-side the same rule is `multiValueMatchKeyRefusal` in `@objectstack/core`.

### Acceptance
- The wizard's field shape carries `multiple` from the object schema.
- "Match on" lists only mapped fields the rule above admits; a multi-value or structured field is never offered.
- No new widget, dialog or hook: a filter on the existing `matchable` list.

### Reader who acts
`domain:ui` seat, next ui card in the import wizard.

### reach
Public door: the Import wizard's "Match on" list, measured on the card's object (customer report on #27465); the server refusal it now meets is pinned in `packages/rest/src/import-multi-value-match-key.test.ts`.

### Dedupe
Search API is unavailable from this session; read instead: the 500 most recent issues (open and closed) by title, grep `import` × `match|wizard|multi` → 4 hits: #27562 (the server-half PR), #27465 (the server half), #27434 (console import matcher never tries unique fields: a different defect), #27190 (exchange-rate import). No duplicate.
